subject: Menos
text: From outside Menos, navigate south twice, cross the bridge, north, east, north twice, west, north twice, east, south, east, and cross the water using the chain flail to find the egg.

evidence.quote: From outside of Menos go south twice, go across the bridge, north, east, north twice, west, north twice, east, south, east, and use the chain to go across the water.

subject: Chocobo
text: Searching the egg causes it to hatch, allowing you to ask the Chocobo and ride it.

evidence.quote: Search the egg and it will hatch. Once you go back across the chasm, ASK the Chocobo. You can now ride on the Chocobo.

subject: Chocobo
text: While riding the Chocobo, you cannot kill any monsters, but monsters cannot attack you either.

evidence.quote: When riding on the Chocobo, you are not able to kill any monsters, but monsters can't attack you either.

subject: Werewolf
text: A group of four Werewolves continually replenishes and can be defeated in one hit with a powered-up thrown weapon from the south screen to gain easy levels.

evidence.quote: While you were walking, you might have noticed a group of four Werewolf monsters. These monsters will let you gain quick and easy levels since they are always replenished, even if you kill all of them. To kill them quickly, you must have a throwing type of weapon equipped. Then go to the screen south of the monsters and wait for your attack bar to max out. Then go north and let your weapon fly, which will kill all the creatures in one shot (if you have sufficient Power stats). You can repeat this over and over again, until you are satisfied with your level.

evidence.quote: From outside Menos, your next destination, Jadd, is (s,s,w,w,n,n,w,n)

evidence.quote: When questioned, Davias says that there is a Medusa in the cave that Amanda went to. The bird that is next to Davias is Amanda's brother!

evidence.quote: Fight outside of Jadd until you find a Bag of Fang. The lizard monster will drop it.

evidence.quote: If you talk to the boy next to the Item shop, he says that he will trade you his clue for a Bag of Fang....Talk to the boy and give him the Bag of Fang. He says, "palm trees, and 8".

evidence.quote: There is also an Inn (s,e,e) of Medusa's Cave.

subject: Jadd
text: Medusa's Cave is located south, east, south, south, east, south, south, west, and north from outside Jadd.

evidence.quote: The cave is located (s,e,s,s,e,s,s,w,n) of outside Jadd.

subject: Medusa's Cave Entrance
text: Dismount from the Chocobo and walk in a sideways figure 8 pattern around the two palm trees two or three times to open Medusa's Cave.

evidence.quote: Dismount from your Chocobo. Now walk a sideways figure 8 around the palm trees. (You might have to do it 2 or 3 times until the cave opens)

subject: Amanda
text: Inside the entrance of the cave, Amanda joins your party after discussing how Davias cursed her brother into a parrot and that she is seeking the Tears of Medusa.

evidence.quote: Walk into the cave and you will see Amanda. She says she took the Pendant in exchange for her brother. Despite this, Davias cursed her brother changing him into a parrot. Amanda is looking for the Tears of Medusa. After a short discussion Amanda will join your group.

subject: Gold Armor
text: On Floor 1, break the south wall with a Mattock, proceed south, west twice, south, west twice, north three times, west, unlock the door with a Key, head south, defeat all enemies, and open the chest for Gold Armor.

evidence.quote: * Floor 1 *  From where you found Amanda, go south and use a Mattock on the south wall. Then go south through the new entrance. Then go west twice, south, west twice and north three times. Then go west, use a Key, south, and kill all the enemies in the room. Then open the chest for a suit of Gold Armor.

subject: Ice Spell
text: On Floor 1, unlock the north door with a Key, go west onto the bottom ice patch to land on the door switch tile, grapple east with the Chain Flail, and enter the east screen to find the Ice Spell chest.

evidence.quote: Then go north, east and use a Key on the north door. Then go north through the now open door. There are two odd tiles here. The one closet to the bottom opens the door, and the other one closes the door. Have your Chain Flail weapon equipped. Go west, and then onto the bottom patch of ice, which will bring you onto the first odd tile. Then use the Chain Flail on the post to the east. Now go east to the next screen. Open the treasure for the Ice Spell.

subject: Recovery Pond
text: Using a Key on the west door and walking into the bottom of the pond restores your HP and MP.

evidence.quote: (If you want, you can use a Key on the west door. Go through the door and go to the bottom of the pond. It will restore your HP and MP)

subject: Floor 1 Snowman Puzzle
text: From the recovery area junction, break the north wall with a Mattock, push the snowman onto the floor tile to open the door, then in the next room use Ice Spell to freeze an enemy onto the odd tile to unlock the stairs down to Floor 2.

evidence.quote: From the room adjacent to the recovery fountain, go south, east and use a Mattock on the north wall. Go through the wall, and then move the frozen snowman onto the tile....Then go north through the door. Use your Ice Spell to freeze and enemy. Then push the frozen enemy onto the odd tile....Then go north through the door, and down the stairs.

subject: Floor 2
text: On Floor 2, head north and proceed down the stairs to Floor 3.

evidence.quote: * Floor 2 * Now go north and down the stairs.

subject: Medusa
text: Medusa shoots three or four snakes from her head; stay below her to dodge the snakes while continually attacking her head with Wind Spear or Chain Flail.

evidence.quote: Best Equipment:     Wind Spear/Chain Flail, Cure Spell...Strategy: The Medusa shoots three or four snakes out of her head. Stay below her and just dodge the snakes. Just keep on attacking Medusa's head and she will eventually die.

subject: Amanda's Tears
text: After Medusa is defeated, Amanda turns into a Medusa due to her injuries, asking you to kill her and search her body for Amanda's Tears, which then transports you out of the cave.

evidence.quote: The Medusa dies, but she leaves no tears. Just as you are ready to leave, Amanda says she was injured and will soon turn into a Medusa. She asks you to kill her and take her tears to her brother. You then kill Amanda. Search her body for the tears. Once you have done this, you will be transported out of the cave.

evidence.quote: Take your Chocobo with you and go back to Jadd. (s,e,n,n,n,w,n,w,n)

subject: Silver Sword

evidence.quote: Some of these monsters are invulnerable to the Wind Spear. I recommend using the Silver Sword.

subject: Lester
text: On Floor 2 of Davias's Mansion, equip Amanda's Tears and talk to the bird to transform him back into Lester, who joins your party.

evidence.quote: * Floor 2 * Go east twice into the room where you first saw Davias and the bird. Davias is gone, but the bird is still there. Equip Amanda's Tears and talk to the bird. He transforms into Lester and joins you group.

subject: Floor 1 Spiral Puzzle
text: On Floor 1, break the north wall with a Mattock, go north twice, unlock the west door with a Key, proceed south a screen, and walk counter-clockwise around the tiles to reveal stairs up to Floor 2.

evidence.quote: * Floor 1 * Now go east twice and use a Mattock on the north wall. Go north twice and use a Key on the door to the west. Go west through the door and go south a screen. Now walk around the tiles counter-clock wise and go up the stairs.

subject: Floor 2 Iron Fence Tile
text: On Floor 2, head west four times, step onto the tile one space north of the iron fence, and walk counter-clockwise until stairs appear leading down to Floor 1.

evidence.quote: * Floor 2 * Go west four times. Now walk onto the odd tile one space north of the iron fence. Now walk counter clockwise until some stairs appear. Now you go down the stairs.

subject: Were Axe
text: On Floor 1, head north, west, and south four times, freeze a monster with Ice Spell, push it onto the odd tile to go east, and eliminate all enemies in the room to make the Were Axe chest appear.

evidence.quote: * Floor 1 * Then go north, west, and south four times. Then use the Ice Spell to freeze the monster. Push him onto the odd tile and go east. Kill all the enemies in this room and a treasure will appear. Open the treasure chest for the Were Axe.

subject: Floor 1 Hidden Wall
text: From the Were Axe room, go west, north twice, break the east wall with a Mattock, go east and south to stairs up to Floor 2, then unlock the north door with a Key and ascend to Floor 3.

evidence.quote:
Now go west, north twice, and use a Mattock on the east wall. Go east, south and up the stairs.

* Floor 2 * Use a Key on the north door and go north. Then go up the stairs.

subject: Davias
text: Davias is encircled by four circling fireballs and throws flame balls; defeat him quickly by slashing with the Were Axe inside his fireball ring, or stay at the bottom dodging flames while throwing powered-up weapons.

evidence.quote: Strategy: Davias is protected by four circling balls of flame. He attacks by shooting a ball of flame at you. He moves east and west across the top of the screen. There are two approaches to defeating Davias. The quickest way is to stay between the circle of fireballs surrounding Davias, and just keep on slashing him with your Were Axe. The longer way to kill Davias is to stay at the bottom of the screen and dodge the fireballs Davias releases. Once your weapon is powered up let it fly at Davias.

Walk to the north side of the trees and then go east, north twice, east, south, south (use the axe), east, north and into the Golem Cave
